features: ⭐ SWEET & SULTRY FUSION – Rich Amber Resin, Sandalwood & Soothing Musk with Light Citrus & Floral Notes of Bergamot, Jasmine, Black Vanilla & Teak. The sustainable and cost-effective way to refill your reed diffuser. Top off your existing LOVSPA essential oil reed diffuser economically with our 4 oz refill. Packaged in recyclable PET bottles for zero waste, just decant the liquid into your decorative diffuser bottle whenever needed.

⭐ REPLACEMENT REEDS INCLUDED – Fragranced oil refill comes in an elegant 4-oz. bottle with resealable so you may use what you need and save the rest for later. Includes an extra set of reeds to optimize performance throughout the life of the diffuser. Replace the first set of reeds when the diffusion rate slows down.

⭐ EASY TO USE – Simply refill your glass LOVSPA diffuser bottle or use your own glass container and place reeds (included) in the diffuser bottle. Reeds absorb the scented oil, draw it to the top and diffuse it into air. Our oil refills are the perfect way to refill an existing diffuser or create a dramatic diffuser accessory of your own.

⭐ LONG LASTING SCENTS – Available in many of our signature scents and more coming soon! When assembled, the essential oils in each bottle absorb into the natural reeds to gently fill the room with fresh, clean aroma. Extend the life of your favorite scented reed diffusers with our convenient and easy-to-use refill oil. Fragrant for 120 days. 4.0 oz.

⭐ TRANSFORMATIVE FRAGRANCES – Replenish your Reed Diffuser Liquid with our NEW & CONVENIENT Refills - available online only and fill your home with the transformative fragrance of our signature aromatic scents. LOVSPA reed diffuser refills continuously deliver a long lasting, true-to-life scent gently throughout its surroundings.
